sql: select strategy, count(*) as trades, min(created_at) as first_trade, max(created_at) as last_trade from paper_trades where strategy like 'Gmmsell%' group by strategy union all select 'mmsell10 (control ref)', count(*), min(created_at), max(created_at) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-06 02:38:00+00'
